chapter: Beginnings and early New Orleans scene
title: Papa Foots and the bouncers
summary: Allen asks about Papa Foots, the strong-arm man who broke up fights with his bare hands, and the big men who worked as bouncers.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Did you have another, you talk about those bouncers, did you have another guy called Foots, Papa Foots?

Foots, all he did around, kind of a strong arm, you know. And just like you got these guys out in Boydman Street, you know what I mean, with like a humbuck store up there, he'd get there and he'd break it up like a referee or something like that. Well that's what he used to do.
No, uh-uh. Nothing with his hands.
He must have been quite a man.
